## Recommendations

All seven findings in the notes are recommended for approval:

1. Rename the purported “binary” algorithm to the Euclidean Jacobi algorithm.
2. Correct the two-power source locator from Hackman B.IV to B.VII.5.
3. Split Jacobi supplements and reciprocity into separate theorems.
4. Separate the unit-square implication from the \(2/15\) counterexample.
5. Add the Jacobi homomorphism and kernel/square-subgroup structure.
6. Add the harvested infinitude corollary for primes \(1\bmod3\).
7. Use distinct generated witnesses, avoiding the published roots-of-one modulo 128 example.

The long reciprocity, Jacobi, and square-root proofs were decomposed into focused lemmas. The corollary pass added the Jacobi obstruction, global root count, and infinitude result. No split is proposed.
